releases.notes:
Mace Neutralizer for Minecraft 1.21.11

## Changes from v1.0.0
- ✨ Updated to Minecraft 1.21.11 (latest stable release)
- 🔧 Migrated to new permission system introduced in MC 1.21.11
- ⬆️ Updated Fabric Loader to 0.18.4
- ⬆️ Updated Fabric API to 0.141.3+1.21.11
- ⬆️ Updated Yarn mappings to 1.21.11+build.4

## Features
- Neutralizes mace damage to 0.5 hearts (fixed damage)
- Keeps wind burst enchantment functional
- Server-side only (clients don't need the mod)
- Command: `/maceneutralizer` to toggle or check status

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.18.4+
- Java 21+

## Installation
Place the jar file in your server's `mods` folder.

---

**Note:** For Minecraft 1.21.10, use [v1.0.0-mc1.21.10](https://github.com/sahibkhokhar/mace-neutralizer/releases/tag/v1.0.0-mc1.21.10)
